column1: # Self-test cases of IEC 60870-5-103 for scripts/interop.sh, against the
# baseline fixture (fixtures/iec103/baseline), unbalanced, every client with
# every server. The outcome line leaves out the identification (checked by
# values.identification in scripts/interop-iec103.sh) and the cyclic
# measurands (cause 2), whose number in a result is not fixed.
# Columns, separated by tabs, as tests/iec101/cases.tsv:
#   1  id      stable dotted scenario id of results.json (prefixed with
#              iec103.unbalanced.); never change it
#   2  state   "ro" (servers are shared) or "rw" (a freshly started server)
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, confirmations (cause, "n" when
#              negative), termination, and type/cause of every received ASDU
#   5  needs   "-", or "server:<feature>" and "client:<feature>", separated by commas
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# The general interrogation answers with the eight indications of the fixture
# that take part in it (160/16..19, 23, 24, 27, 36; not 160/68), cause 9.
# The commands use pairs of table 17 that are typical for the device's function
# type (160: INF 16..19), with the values of its COM column (INF 19: ON only),
# so that a client that follows the table sends every one. 160/18 is a valid
# pair the fixture does not take: the station refuses it with cause 21, as it
# refuses DCO 3. A positive command is acknowledged with cause 20 and its
# change of state follows with cause 12 (clause 7.4.4, figure 7); the client
# collects for 500 ms after the acknowledgement to receive it.
case.connect
case.interrogate
case.interrogate-scn-200
case.clock-sync
case.monitor
case.command-160-18-not-taken
case.command-160-16-dco-3
case.command-160-16-off
case.command-160-19-on
